doc: A browser.private card for a name (printer.local) or for the host's loopback through host.drgnx.internal offers that one target only: no CIDR and no all private, since a width admits literals and never a name, and the host's own services are granted one port at a time. The title names the target, the pinned address and its class. What makes it fail: a width offered for a name (a rebinding door) or for this computer.

sql: select title, (select group_concat(json_extract(value, '$.id'), ' ') from json_each(card.data, '$.choices')) from card where id = $c1
rows: s1 wants to open printer.local:631 → 192.168.1.20:631 (your LAN)

sql: select title, (select group_concat(json_extract(value, '$.id'), ' ') from json_each(card.data, '$.choices')) from card where id = $c2
rows: s1 wants to open host.drgnx.internal:5173 → 127.0.0.1:5173 (this computer)
